title: H-1 lifetime / atomic-oxygen degradation register and witness / coupon / metrology provisions

milestones.A: Supplies the life/AO conditions a CONDITIONAL_BASELINE(X) must carry (all common-mode, so they do not discriminate hall_only / rf_hall / ecr_hall): (1) anode material/design whose oxidation on the delivered composition does not change the discharge over the firing life (AOL-M01); (2) wall grade N/O erosion life demonstrated (AOL-M02/M03); (3) C-1 tolerance of the measured cathode-region exposure (AOL-M04/M05); (4) exterior materials compatible with the mission AO fluence (AOL-M09). It eliminates nothing.
milestones.B: Not a performance input. Wall/erosion evidence stays evidence-only until an admitted closure exists (credible set empty) or H-1 near-wall data exist.
milestones.C: Defines the witness / replaceable-part / metrology provisions without which no H-1 life evidence can be produced for the PDR life closure (G4_firing_life, P2_cathode).
to_reach_next: owner review of this DRAFT and of AOL-OQ-01..06
W3 and W4 adopt the interface-table rows before W3 merges (control C5 integration check)
LOCK-1: facility and metrology-lab choice; coupon positions frozen
S1: baselines (AOL-PM-01) and first exposure data; LOCK-2 sets AOL-PT-02/03
C: pre-registered endurance segment (AOL-LF-02) plus AOL-EX-01..03 results

hard_statements: DRAFT for owner review. Every requirement is PROPOSED; every threshold not in the RFP is PROPOSED.

No life number for H-1 exists. Life entries are literature on another device (labelled, not transferred as a verdict) or TBD (control C6). No 15,000 h extrapolation is made from any Hall closure; the credible set is empty.
No Hall map, screening candidate (sgb-screen-*), unadmitted closure or withdrawn 0-D number is used anywhere.

Witness and metrology data are not model-promotion evidence until the W5 pre-registration is frozen (execution directive data_rule); the same data never both select and validate a closure (control C1).
Nothing here is a design variable of the intake, compressor, gas chambers or valves; Hall-closure uncertainty does not leak upstream.
No architecture is ranked or eliminated: every mechanism is common-mode except AOL-M10 (module-specific, monitored).
Nothing is wired into archengine or any abep_sim module; goldens are untouched.

References to W3 / W4 draft ids (HW-*, INS-*) are unverified, non-binding merge hints from unmerged drafts; they are listed in unmerged_draft_references and must be re-verified after the W3 / W4 merge.

ANDREUSSI2022.citation: T. Andreussi, E. Ferrato, V. Giannetti, 'A review of air-breathing electric propulsion: from mission studies to technology verification', J. Electr. Propuls. 1:31 (2022)
ANDREUSSI2022.note: Springer copy (57 pages; locators 'Page N of 57'). lane HSUS recorded the IRIS copy (sha256 092befad...), same article, different bytes. Review: evidence level 5 for what it reports second-hand.

CIFALI2011.citation: G. Cifali, T. Misuri, P. Rossetti, M. Andrenucci, D. Valentian, D. Feili, B. Lotz, 'Experimental characterization of HET and RIT with atmospheric propellants', IEPC-2011-224 (2011)
CIFALI2011.note: same bytes as recorded by lane HSUS (docs/evidence/hall_sustainment/). Page locators are the printed page numbers.

CIFALI2012.citation: G. Cifali et al., 'Completion of HET and RIT characterization with atmospheric propellants', Space Propulsion 2012, SP2012-2355386 (as identified by lane HSUS; ANDREUSSI2022 ref. [97])
CIFALI2012.note: primary of the 314 h endurance result; not located openly. Content used only as reported by ANDREUSSI2022 Page 24 of 57. Acquisition candidate for the closed-access list (control C4).

DEGROH2006.citation: K. K. de Groh, B. A. Banks, C. E. McCarthy, R. N. Rucker, L. M. Roberts, L. A. Berger, 'MISSE PEACE Polymers Atomic Oxygen Erosion Results', NASA/TM-2006-214482 (November 2006)
DEGROH2006.note: Locators are the printed page numbers ('NASA/TM-2006-214482 N'). Flight: MISSE 2 PEC 2 tray 1 (E5) on the ISS exterior, installed 16 Aug 2001, nearly 4 years (pp. 1, 9); mission planning assumed a 400 km circular orbit at 51.6 deg (p. 5). Exposure included solar and charged-particle radiation (p. 16). AO environment as stated in the introduction (printed p. 1, a review statement citing the source's ref. [1], not a MISSE measurement): ISS-altitude ram flux ~5.23e13 atoms/cm2/s for normal-incident ram surfaces (400 km, averaged over the 11-year solar cycle) and 'the average energy of an oxygen atom impacting spacecraft at ram velocities is 4.5 eV'.

mechanisms.title: Anode / gas-distributor oxidation
mechanisms.energy_statement: Chemical oxidation by the O-bearing anode feed and discharge-produced atomic O at the anode temperature (TBD - requires H-1 thermal design / S1 anode thermocouple, W3 HW-H1-07). Ion bombardment of the anode is not identified as the driver in any accessed source.
mechanisms.degradation_mode: oxide growth on the anode surface; rising electrical (contact) resistance; anomalous discharge behaviour and spontaneous flame-outs in the one recorded endurance test
measurable_quantities: oxide thickness and composition (SEM cross-section, EDS, XPS)
anode-to-terminal electrical resistance (4-wire, pre/post and in situ if designed in)
flame-out count and time stamps; I_d oscillation statistics during O-bearing operation
visual / photographic state at each inspection (borescope if in situ)

evidence.statement: After a 10 h N2/O2 firing of the PPS1350-TSD the anode 'seems rusty', explained by reaction with oxygen; 'with respect to a future endurance test the anode oxidation with the consequent increase in electrical resistance is the main concern'.
evidence.applicability: PPS1350-TSD, 305 V, 2.75 mg/s 1.27N2 + O2, Xe start and Xe cathode, facility-fed, 10 h; visual inspection only (qualitative)
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: 'In order to limit anode oxidation', the planned pure-O2 test of the PPS1350-TSD was replaced by the 1.27N2 + O2 mixture.
evidence.applicability: test-planning statement (no oxidation measurement)
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: PPS1350 on N2/O2 + 10 % Xe mass flow, 305 V, 2.75 mg/s: steady for 'about 314 hours' at 3.8-4 A; then 'severe oxidation of the anode produced anomalous discharge behavior and a spontaneous flame-out' and a refurbishment (cleaning); 'in the subsequent 75 hrs of firing several flame-outs occurred likely linked to the oxidation of the anode surface and the test was prematurely stopped'. The authors suggest oxidation-resistant anode materials.
evidence.applicability: PPS1350 (flight-type SPT, not H-1), 10 % Xe in the anode flow, facility-fed, Xe start; second-hand (primary CIFALI2012 not accessed); anode material not stated in the accessed text
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: Same datum recorded as hall-sustainment E07 and veto-layer RI-LIFE-HALL-ANODE-OXIDATION; W3 draft HW-H1-05 already requires anode inspection after O-bearing operation.
evidence.applicability: as stated by the referenced lane
evidence.transfer: referenced lane record; NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

life_number.statement: ~314 h to first flame-out on a PPS1350 with 10 % Xe (second-hand). A duration on another device and feed; not an H-1 life and not extrapolated.

required_experiment.ground_ao_source: Anode-material coupons (H-1 anode material plus owner-selected oxidation-resistant candidates; no candidate is sourced here) exposed to O2 and to an atomic-O source at the anode temperature range (TBD, from S1): mass, oxide thickness, XPS, resistance (AOL-EX-02).
required_experiment.in_thruster_witness: Replaceable, serialized anode with baseline metrology (AOL-RC-01); anode-material witness coupons at the distributor outlet region if the design allows without changing the flow path (AOL-WC-02); in-situ resistance lead (AOL-RC-02); flame-out logging (AOL-CX-06, AOL-DC-02).

mechanisms.architecture_scope: common_mode (the anode is part of the common H-1); a pre-ionizer may change the atomic-O share reaching the anode (W7 / lane 19 note) - TBD, measured per arm by AOL-WC-05

mechanisms.title: Channel-wall physical sputtering by N+, N2+, O+, O2+ and Xe+ (incl. multiply charged)
components: H-1 channel walls (BN, BN-SiO2 or alternative grade; owner decision)
mechanisms.energy_statement: Wall impact energy = sheath drop plus the ion's axial energy and angle; the solver's WallSheath value Z*phi_s + T_e/2 omits both and is not a validated erosion input (lane 32 use restriction 1). Lane 32 proposes coupon tests at 20-300 eV, 0-85 deg (H1). Per-projectile / per-target / per-energy coverage of the lane 32 database is indexed in derived.wall_sputter_index (register section 5b). H-1 values: TBD - requires near-wall diagnostics (lane 32 H7) or an ADMITTED closure.
mechanisms.degradation_mode: wall recession profile, exit chamfer growth, eventual pole-piece exposure
measurable_quantities: wall erosion profile (contact or optical profilometry / laser scan against fiducials) at every stage
wall-ring mass change (dehydrated protocol; BN is hygroscopic-sensitive: moisture uptake flagged by lane 32 SURFACE_STATE)

evidence.statement: No measured N+, N2+, O+ or O2+ sputter yield on BN, BN-SiO2 or SiC was located; Xe+ on BN differs up to 11.8x between laboratories; thresholds are not identified; any N/O lookup on the primary wall materials is OUT_OF_DOMAIN -> NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
evidence.applicability: as stated by the referenced lane
evidence.transfer: referenced lane record; NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: PPS1350 on N2/O2 + 10 % Xe: 'the ceramic erosion was still compatible with a 7000-9500 hrs lifetime' (authors' estimate; method not given in the review).
evidence.applicability: PPS1350, 10 % Xe, second-hand; wear-model extrapolation of unknown method
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: Counter-indicator: magnetically shielded SITAEL HT5k DM2 on N2/O2, shielding 'seems effective', no critical damage after a cumulative 10 h air test (qualitative).
evidence.applicability: as stated by the referenced lane
evidence.transfer: referenced lane record; NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

life_number.statement: 7000-9500 h authors' erosion-compatible estimate on a PPS1350 (second-hand, model-derived). Not an H-1 life; lane 24 basis engineering_estimate, never verdict-bearing. H-1 wall life: TBD - requires measured N/O yields on the H-1 grade plus a measured H-1 erosion profile (no admitted closure exists).

mechanisms.title: Cathode emitter poisoning by O / O2 / H2O (LaB6 baseline; BaO-W, C12A7 alternatives)
mechanisms.energy_statement: Neutral back-flow from the plume and facility background to the hot emitter; emitter-region O partial pressure TBD - not measurable directly (lane 10 G02; W3 draft HW-C1-03).
mechanisms.degradation_mode: work-function rise, higher emitter temperature or heater power needed, ignition failure, plume-mode growth (and hence Xe consumption, lane 19)
measurable_quantities: keeper voltage and coupling voltage at a fixed Xe reference condition (daily)
heater power and time-to-ignition at every start
emitter temperature (pyrometer or thermocouple, if designed in)
RGA partial pressures near the cathode

evidence.statement: LaB6: O2 at ~1e-5 Torr degrades emission below 1440 degC; tolerates up to 1e-4 Torr at 1570 degC (textbook statement of diode tests). BaO-W: ~1e-7 Torr O2 fully poisons at 1100 degC. No atomic-O or N2 data for either.
evidence.applicability: as stated by the referenced lane
evidence.transfer: referenced lane record; NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

mechanisms.title: External atomic-oxygen exposure of the thruster exterior in VLEO (ram AO)
mechanisms.energy_statement: Ram impact energy E = 0.5 m_O V^2 (model-derived; values per altitude in derived.ao_environment.table E_ram_O_eV); thermal spread and co-rotation neglected.
mechanisms.degradation_mode: polymer recession / mass loss, graphite erosion, metal oxidation, optical property change
measurable_quantities: recession depth (profilometry against a protected reference)

evidence.statement: MISSE 2 flight erosion yields (Table 4), e.g. Kapton H 3.00E-24, FEP 2.00E-25, PTFE 1.42E-25, pyrolytic graphite 4.15E-25 cm3/atom; fluence 8.43E21 atoms/cm2 from Kapton H witnesses.
evidence.applicability: ISS exterior (~4 years), AO + solar UV + charged particles; polymers and graphite only
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: Reference AO environment at ISS altitude, stated in the introduction as a review statement citing the source's ref. [1] (not measured by MISSE): ram flux ~5.23e13 atoms/cm2/s on normal-incident ram surfaces (400 km, 11-year solar-cycle average) and average ram impact energy 4.5 eV. The register's model-derived E_ram at 180-230 km (derived.ao_environment) is higher; the difference is not corrected for when MISSE yields are used illustratively. Level 5: the document is primary for its flight yields (level 3) but only restates this environment value from its ref. [1]; the original quantity type is not stated there, so it is carried as 'inferred'.
evidence.unit: eV (average ram O impact energy, ISS altitude)
evidence.applicability: ISS altitude (400 km); second-hand within the source (its ref. [1]); environment context only
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

evidence.statement: Method: erosion yield from mass loss with a Kapton H witness for fluence (Eqs. 1-3); Kapton absorbs up to 2 % of its weight in moisture, so samples are dehydrated in a vacuum desiccator before pre- and post-flight weighing (60-100 mtorr, >= 4 days, 3 readings averaged).
evidence.applicability: measurement protocol (transferable as a METHOD, not as a value)
evidence.transfer: literature on another device or environment: recorded, NOT transferred to H-1 as a verdict

requirements.title: Near-exit plume witness array
requirements.requirement: H-1 test installation shall provide a fixed witness holder carrying coupons of the wall grade, anode material, pole material and owner-selected candidates at pre-registered positions outside the beam core.
requirements.rationale: Only in-plume coupons of the actual H-1 materials give N/O-environment erosion and oxidation evidence; lane 32 has no N/O yield on BN, BN-SiO2 or SiC.
requirements.install_phase: design-in before S1; installed from first ignition
requirements.verification: Inspection: holder drawing and position record; Test: B(z) re-map and thrust-stand tare with the holder installed show no change beyond W4 instrument uncertainty (value TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Anode-material witness at the distributor
requirements.requirement: If W3 can place it without altering the flow path or anode area, H-1 shall carry an anode-material witness at the distributor region; otherwise W3 records why not and AOL-RC-01 is the anode witness.
requirements.rationale: Anode oxidation is the recorded endurance limiter on an N2/O2 SPT (AOL-M01).
requirements.verification: Inspection of the drawing; analysis that flow path and anode area are unchanged.

requirements.title: Cathode-vicinity witness set
requirements.requirement: The C-1 mount shall carry keeper-material, unheated LaB6 and insulator-ceramic witness coupons at fixed positions.
requirements.rationale: Cathode exposure to N/O plume back-flow is unquantified (lane 10 U03-U05).
requirements.verification: Inspection of mount drawing and installed positions (photographic record).

requirements.title: Magnetic-circuit material witness pair
requirements.requirement: MC-1 shall carry a plume-exposed and a shadowed pole-material coupon, each with a thermocouple.
requirements.rationale: No oxidation evidence for magnetic materials in an N/O plume was accessed (AOL-M06).
requirements.verification: Inspection; thermocouple channels listed in the W4 channel map.

requirements.title: Per-arm interstage witness set
requirements.requirement: The module interface shall carry an interstage witness set at an identical position in HW-0, HW-RF and HW-ECR, exchanged only at arm boundaries under the W3 installation-reproducibility procedure.
requirements.rationale: Module erosion products and extra atomic O could alter the common hardware between arms (AOL-M10).
requirements.install_phase: design-in before S1 (HW-0 blank position exists from S1)
requirements.verification: Demonstration: exchange procedure executed in S1 without changing the HW-0 reference beyond the LOCK-2 repeatability (TBD - LOCK-2).

requirements.title: Control coupons
requirements.requirement: Every witness lot shall have facility-background, beam-dump-facing, shadowed and lab-stored controls.
requirements.rationale: Separates facility deposits and handling from plume effects (AOL-M11).
requirements.verification: Inspection of the coupon register (serials, lot, positions).

requirements.title: Replaceable, serialized anode
requirements.requirement: The H-1 anode (and distributor if integral) shall be removable and re-installable with a documented torque / alignment procedure, serialized, with baseline metrology before first ignition.
requirements.rationale: Anode oxidation needs direct post-test metrology; the PPS1350 anode required refurbishment after ~314 h (AOL-M01). Per W3 draft HW-H1-02 any replacement downstream of IP-DN creates H-1' with a new HW-0 reference; removal is therefore scheduled only at pre-registered phase boundaries.
requirements.verification: Inspection of drawings; demonstration of one remove/re-install cycle before S1 with B(z) and HW-0 reference re-measured.

requirements.title: In-situ anode resistance lead
requirements.requirement: H-1 shall provide a separate sense lead so that anode-to-terminal resistance can be measured 4-wire between blocks without disassembly.
requirements.rationale: Cifali 2011 names the resistance increase from anode oxidation as the main endurance concern (p. 5).
requirements.verification: Test: resistance measured at S1 baseline with stated uncertainty (TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Replaceable exit-region wall rings with fiducials
requirements.requirement: The exit-region channel wall shall be separate replaceable rings carrying fiducial reference marks for profilometry, with as-built geometry recorded (W3 draft HW-H1-03).
requirements.rationale: Wall erosion on N/O is unquantified for every grade (AOL-M02, AOL-M03); rings allow profile and mass metrology without destroying H-1.
requirements.verification: Inspection of drawings; profilometry baseline repeatability measured at S1 (value TBD - W4).

requirements.title: Optional alternative-grade sector inserts (owner decision)
requirements.requirement: If the owner approves, small wall sector inserts of alternative grades shall be identical in all arms and recorded as part of the H-1 configuration.
requirements.rationale: Would give comparative N/O wall data in the same plasma; it changes H-1 design-representativeness (W3 draft HW-H1-01), so it is an owner decision (AOL-OQ-02).
requirements.verification: Inspection of configuration record.

requirements.title: Daily Xe reference check of C-1
requirements.requirement: C-1 keeper and coupling voltage shall be recorded daily at a fixed Xe reference condition.
requirements.rationale: Trend detection of emitter degradation (AOL-M04, AOL-M05); aligns with W3 draft HW-C1-03 / D-15-B.
requirements.verification: Test record per day; reference condition frozen in LOCK-1.

requirements.title: Start log
requirements.requirement: Every C-1 start shall log heater power, heater time to ignition, keeper ignition voltage and outcome.
requirements.rationale: Ignition degradation was the observed failure mode of the RAM-HET cathode (not attributed to poisoning).
requirements.verification: DAQ record for every start.

requirements.title: Cathode gas-composition sampling
requirements.requirement: A sampling point near C-1 shall feed the RGA (W4 draft INS-11) so O2 / H2O / N2 partial pressures near the cathode are logged during O-bearing operation.
requirements.rationale: Emitter-region O partial pressure is not measurable directly (lane 10 G02); a near-cathode proxy is the minimum.
requirements.verification: Demonstration of calibrated RGA sampling at S1 (calibration TBD).

requirements.title: Emitter / cathode temperature
requirements.requirement: C-1 emitter or cathode-tube temperature shall be measured (pyrometer or thermocouple, per W4) during firing.
requirements.rationale: LaB6 O2 tolerance depends on emitter temperature (lane 10 section 3.1).
requirements.verification: Channel in the W4 map with stated uncertainty (TBD).

requirements.title: Hot-emitter O-exposure interlock log
requirements.requirement: Every interval during which the emitter is hot while O2 is present in the chamber or feed shall be logged, with Xe cathode flow state (W3 draft HW-C1-03 rule).
requirements.rationale: Exposure dose accounting for C-1.
requirements.verification: Log exists for every block; interlock states recorded.

requirements.title: Flame-out and anomaly log
requirements.requirement: Every spontaneous extinction, ignition failure and anomalous-discharge episode shall be time-stamped with feed composition, I_d trace and cathode state.
requirements.rationale: Flame-outs were the observable symptom of anode oxidation on the PPS1350 (AOL-M01).
requirements.verification: Extinction detection (W4 draft INS-10) record per block.

requirements.title: Wall and anode thermocouples for life mechanisms
requirements.requirement: Thermocouples shall exist on the anode, the exit-region wall rings and next to each witness coupon.
requirements.rationale: Oxidation and sputter yields depend on temperature (lane 32 section 3; lane 15 BN oxidizing limit).
requirements.verification: Channel map and drawing.

requirements.title: Baseline metrology before first ignition
requirements.requirement: Every witness coupon, replaceable part, anode, wall ring and C-1 keeper shall be measured before first ignition (mass, profile, SEM/EDS, XPS as listed per item, resistance, photographs), with instrument, uncertainty and operator recorded.
requirements.rationale: Without a baseline no post-test difference is interpretable.
requirements.verification: Baseline records exist for every serialized item.

requirements.title: Dehydrated mass protocol
requirements.requirement: Mass measurements of hygroscopic items (polymers, BN) shall follow a dehydrated protocol (vacuum desiccator, fixed time under vacuum, repeated readings averaged, room temperature and humidity logged) identical pre and post; parameters TBD - W4 / metrology lab.
requirements.rationale: Kapton absorbs up to 2 % of its weight in moisture (NASA/TM-2006-214482 p. 3); lane 32 flags moisture uptake for BN (SURFACE_STATE).
requirements.verification: Repeatability of a control coupon demonstrated before S1 (value TBD).

requirements.title: Channel erosion profile at each stage
requirements.requirement: The wall-ring profile shall be measured against fiducials at S1 end, at each phase boundary and at campaign end.
requirements.rationale: W3 draft HW-H1-04 requires an erosion profile at each stage; lane 32 H6 needs it.
requirements.verification: Profile data with uncertainty per stage.

requirements.title: Surface analysis
requirements.requirement: Post-test SEM/EDS (morphology, deposits), XPS (oxidation state, depth profile) shall be applied to the items listed per coupon; samples transferred in sealed dry containers with custody record.
requirements.rationale: Distinguishes oxidation, nitridation, deposits and facility contamination.
requirements.verification: Analysis report per item referencing its baseline.

requirements.title: Cathode post-test inspection
requirements.requirement: At campaign end (or C-1 retirement), insert, orifice and keeper shall be inspected: orifice diameter, keeper-face profile, SEM/EDS and XPS of the insert surface.
requirements.rationale: Lane 10 G02/G04.
requirements.verification: Inspection report.

requirements.title: Electrical resistance and insulation tests
requirements.requirement: Anode resistance (AOL-RC-02) and insulation resistance of anode isolator, coils and harness shall be measured at baseline, every phase boundary and campaign end.
requirements.rationale: AOL-M01, AOL-M07.
requirements.verification: Measurement record with uncertainty (TBD).

requirements.title: SEE yield of wall material (if facility allows)
requirements.requirement: SEE yield of wall-ring / coupon material before and after N/O exposure shall be measured if an accessible facility exists (lane 32 H9).
requirements.rationale: SEE sets the sheath and hence impact energy; also a Hall-map schema v2 field.
requirements.verification: Report or recorded as not feasible.

requirements.title: B(z) re-map and magnetic-circuit inspection
requirements.requirement: Adopt W3 draft HW-MC-03 and HW-MC-04 (B(z) at actual coil currents before/after each block series, reference sensor during firing) and add a visual / XPS inspection of the pole faces at campaign end.
requirements.rationale: AOL-M06 degradation shows as B(z) drift.
requirements.verification: Map records.

requirements.title: Optical properties
requirements.requirement: Solar absorptance and hemispherical emissivity of exterior / coated coupons shall be measured pre and post ground AO exposure.
requirements.rationale: AOL-M08, AOL-M09 thermal consequences.
requirements.verification: Measurement report.

requirements.title: Ground AO exposure of exterior materials
requirements.requirement: H-1 / C-1 exterior material candidates shall be exposed in a ground AO facility with a Kapton H fluence witness (DEGROH2006 Eqs. 1-3 method) to a target fluence chosen by the owner from derived.ao_environment; facility and AO energy TBD - owner channel.
requirements.rationale: Mission ram fluence exceeds the MISSE 2 flight fluence by the tabulated factor; no open erosion yield for BN, alumina or metals was accessed.
requirements.install_phase: parallel to S1; not on the S1 critical path
requirements.verification: Exposure report with fluence witness.

requirements.title: Combined ion + atomic-O coupon exposure of internal materials
requirements.requirement: Wall grade, anode material and candidates, keeper, pole and insulator materials shall be exposed to controlled O2 / atomic-O (and ions where available) at their operating temperatures (lane 32 H4).
requirements.rationale: Separates chemistry from the plasma environment of H-1.
requirements.verification: Exposure reports.

requirements.title: Heated emitter exposure
requirements.requirement: LaB6 (and alternatives if kept) emitter coupons shall be exposed hot to O2 / atomic O / H2O with emission measured (lane 10 G02, G03).
requirements.rationale: Only O2 / H2O diode data exist; no atomic-O data.
requirements.verification: Exposure report.

requirements.title: Exposure log and coupon register
requirements.requirement: A coupon/part register (serial, lot, material, position, install/remove timestamps, cumulative exposure per feed composition, arm and block) shall be kept under the W5 data-custody plan; metrology operators receive coded sample IDs (PROPOSED).
requirements.rationale: Attribution per arm and per mechanism; blinding against expectation bias.
requirements.verification: Register audit before LOCK-2.

requirements.title: Evidence records compatible with thermal_life measured_hardware
requirements.requirement: Every life-relevant measurement shall be recorded with the fields test_article, facility, document, measurement_method, uncertainty, operating_point, applicability_domain (schemas/thermal_life/inputs_v1.json measured_hardware) so it can later enter abep_sim/thermal_life.py without an admitted closure.
requirements.rationale: The only non-closure path for wall-flux / life inputs in thermal_life is measured_hardware.
requirements.verification: Schema check of records.

requirements.title: No life extrapolation from an unadmitted closure (C6)
requirements.requirement: No H-1 life number shall be computed from a Hall map, screening candidate (sgb-screen-*) or withdrawn 0-D result; life statements are measured on H-1, literature for another device (labelled), or TBD.
requirements.rationale: Credible set is empty (gate 3 FAIL); control C6.
requirements.verification: Review; the register test asserts it for this register.

requirements.title: Endurance durations and acceptance pre-registered
requirements.requirement: Any wear / endurance segment and its acceptance criteria shall be pre-registered before data (duration TBD - owner); S1 results never alter a pre-registered decision threshold.
requirements.rationale: Execution directive LOCK-2 rule; lane 10 G04.
requirements.verification: Pre-registration document exists before data.

misse2_fluence_atoms_cm2.note: from two Kapton H witness samples; ISS exterior, ~4 years

equations.n_O: n_O = rho * fO / m_O  (same relation as abep_sim.atmosphere 'n_O')
equations.E_ram: E = 0.5 * m_O * V^2 / e  (kinetic energy of an O atom in the spacecraft frame, co-rotation and thermal motion neglected; compare DEGROH2006 p. 1: 4.5 eV average at ISS altitude, review statement)
equations.recession_equivalent: x = E_y * F  (linear, fluence-independent yield ASSUMED)

flags: RAM_NORMAL_UPPER_BOUND: flux onto a surface facing the ram direction at normal incidence. An ABEP thruster sits behind the intake; the actual exposure of each H-1 exterior surface is TBD - requires the spacecraft layout and a free-molecular / DSMC view-factor analysis (owner/system design).
NO_COROTATION_NO_THERMAL: atmospheric co-rotation and O thermal motion are neglected (they change the relative speed and let non-ram surfaces receive flux).
FROZEN_SCENARIO_ONLY: one epoch, orbit-averaged; no solar-cycle-averaged mission profile. The F10.7 70-230 columns bracket activity; the mission F10.7 history is TBD - requires the mission profile.
COMPOSITION_SUM: fO is the O mass fraction of O+N2+O2 while rho includes the dropped species (He, H, Ar, N; < 2 % by mass at 180-230 km per the frozen metadata), so n_O is high by at most that share.

OTHER_ENVIRONMENT (recession only): MISSE 2 yields are ISS-exterior values (planning orbit 400 km, 51.6 deg; AO with solar UV and charged particles). The source states an average ram impact energy of 4.5 eV at ISS altitude (DEGROH2006 printed p. 1, review statement citing its ref. [1]); E_ram here is model-derived for 180-230 km (see table, ~5 eV). The ~0.5 eV difference and any energy dependence of the yield are NOT corrected for; no energy or synergy correction is applied, so the MISSE yields transfer only as an uncorrected illustration.
FLUENCE_EXTRAPOLATION (recession only): mission fluences exceed the MISSE 2 fluence by the 'ratio_to_misse2_fluence' factor; a linear yield beyond the tested fluence is ASSUMED.

illustrative_recession_equivalents.status: ILLUSTRATIVE, OUT_OF_DOMAIN (flags above). Shows only that polymer exterior parts on a ram-exposed surface would not survive the mission fluence unprotected; it is never a design margin, a coating thickness or a verdict. Metals, BN, alumina and other ceramics: no open erosion yield accessed by this lane -> TBD (AOL-EX-01).
illustrative_recession_equivalents.rounding: computed from unrounded fluences; stored fluence 4 significant figures, ratio and range 6, recession 3
